job.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photorealistic frame from a podcast video. A calm confident Russian man about 48 with a very short grey crew cut, neat grey stubble, thin metal-rimmed glasses, wearing a crisp white shirt with open collar and a dark leather watch. He sits at a white round table, a black podcast microphone on a boom arm in front of him at chest level (not covering his face or mouth), a dark paper coffee cup on the table, hands relaxed on the table. He looks straight into the camera, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, serious calm expression, NO smile. Medium shot from the waist up, both shoulders inside the frame, face large and sharp, top of head about 18% below the upper edge. Background: dark studio, brown curtain, a big potted palm and warm dim light, softly blurred. Real camera frame, NOT CGI. No text, no logos, no watermark.
